This is not a gas peak.' 8) The shift of Halo A due to the fixed B/C haloes is 1.2 arcsec. 9) Direction: 'BCG-B is out of the frame to the North West (or top right) direction from BCG-A' - conflicts with the 'NW' wording in the assignment.
